text: 40岁是种什么感觉？
en: What does it feel like to be 40?

text: 绝望。
en: Despair.

text: 快速消逝。
en: Fading fast.

text: 绝望是无论好坏一眼望到头。
en: Despair is seeing the end of everything at a glance, whether for better or worse.

text: 不像20岁，有很多种可能性，有很多种想法。
en: Not like being 20, when there are many possibilities and many ideas.

text: 能达到的，达不到的，都大概可以推算出来。
en: What can be achieved and what cannot are more or less calculable.

text: 也不是说不能重头再来，只是说大部分事情。
en: It is not to say one cannot start over, only that this applies to most things.

text: 干了很多年的行业，身边的朋友，爱好，已婚的你的老公，你的孩子。
en: The industry you have worked in for years, the friends around you, your hobbies, your husband if married, your children.

text: 未婚的，大概率就可以做一个人过一辈子的打算了。
en: If unmarried, you can most likely plan to spend the rest of your life alone.

text: 曾经的愿望，能实现的大概也实现了，实现不了的，就是努力了但是没那个能力。
en: Of the wishes you once had, those that could come true mostly have, and those that have not are the ones you strove for but lacked the ability for.

text: 年少时觉得时光很慢，七月树影下，考试前窗前的树，迷迷糊糊半睡着的课桌上，自由活动的体育课。
en: In youth time felt slow: the tree shadows in July, the tree by the window before exams, the desk where you dozed off half-asleep, the PE lesson with free activity.

text: 三个小时的素描课也好像一天有很长很长。
en: Even a three-hour sketching class felt like a day, so very long.

text: 好像一辈子都可以这样。
en: As if life could go on like this forever.

text: 30-40岁，就不知道发生了什么，感觉这10年，一年就过完了。
en: From 30 to 40 you hardly know what happened; these ten years feel as though they passed in a single year.

text: 留下的，就只有发出的腮，白了的头发，不怎么好的颈椎腰椎，还有不怎么吃就胖起来的肉。
en: What remains is only protruding cheeks, white hair, a less-than-healthy neck and lumbar spine, and flesh that fattens up even without eating much.

text: 在外人看来，我从小略有慧根，谓之仁义；在同龄人中确实也较早拥有自知之明。
en: To outsiders I seemed to have a bit of innate wisdom from a young age, deemed benevolent and righteous; among my peers I did indeed gain self-knowledge relatively early.

text: 看多了长辈们的分分合合、或坚忍或自弃，始终对人到中年心存敬畏。
en: Having seen elders' partings and reunions, their endurance or their self-abandonment, I have always held a quiet reverence for reaching middle age.

text: 走南闯北漂泊倦了，遇到比较合心意的伴侣便义无反顾克服阻力安顿下来，齐心把小家庭经营了十年，和和美美也难免各种小不如意，时至不惑，深知仍需谨慎，慢慢理解人活的是自己的执念，忠于本心方得始终。
en: Having grown tired of wandering north and south, I met a partner who suited me well and, without hesitation, overcame the resistance to settle down. Together we built our small family for ten years; though harmonious, it was not without its minor frustrations. Now at the age of understanding, I know one must remain cautious, and slowly comprehend that a person lives by their own obsession; only by staying true to one's heart can one see things through.

text: 内心仍有个少年，偶尔避开妻儿躲入GTA城市中漫步放空，光影袭来，恍惚间已是剧中人，孑然一身
en: Inside there is still a youth; occasionally I slip away from wife and children and wander, emptying my mind in the city of GTA. As light and shadow wash over me, in a trance I have already become a figure within the scene, utterly alone

text: 有点感慨，来更新一下～
en: A little moved, I have come to update this～

text: 四十左右一般还好吧，我觉得五十才算深度中年。
en: Around forty is generally all right, I think; fifty is when one truly enters deep middle age.

text: 81年的我，父母健在，退休小十年，不到七十，身体尚可，今年回老家过年，二老还给了我和儿媳、孙子各一份红包
en: Born in '81, my parents are still alive, retired for nearly ten years, not yet seventy, in fair health. This year I returned to my hometown for the New Year, and the two elders still gave a red envelope each to me, my daughter-in-law and my grandson.

text: 平时，无非就是三口之家独自在外工作生活，连轴转，统筹好。
en: Usually it is just the three of us working and living away from home on our own, a relentless whirl, managed well.

text: 车险大病险寿险基本保障到了，也怕有意外打乱节奏，买东西看重稳定性可靠性，工科生，懂一点，花钱是小，添乱是大
en: Car, critical-illness and life insurance cover the basic safeguards; yet I fear an accident disrupting the rhythm, so when buying things I value stability and reliability. As an engineering graduate who knows a little, I think spending money is minor, but causing trouble is the real problem.

text: 好像是巴菲特说过，好东西更保值
en: I think Buffett once said that good things hold their value better.

text: 前阵子，厨房厨柜里漏水，自己排出问题所在，瓶瓶罐罐高接低挡对付了大半个月，周六一早请了小区外五金店的老板大哥抽空来看一眼，来的时候临近中午，拆了看看，试着修补，接口不同，我也急着出门，带孩子上个小班课，媳妇边蒸着包子，边帮师傅打手电，没多久电话跟我说，判断是阀芯漏水，得换，原本以为换两根软管就好的，只得暂时做罢，大哥也实在，走了，都没推销推销合适的产品。
en: Recently the kitchen cabinets leaked; I found the problem myself and, propping bottles and jars high and low, coped for the better part of half a month. Early Saturday morning I asked the boss—a friendly older fellow—from the hardware shop outside the estate to spare a moment to take a look. He arrived close to noon, took it apart to inspect and tried a repair, but the fittings differed. I was also in a hurry to go out and take my child to a small group class, while my wife, steaming buns, held a torch for the repairman. Before long she phoned to tell me he had judged it was the valve core leaking and it needed replacing; we had thought swapping two hoses would do, so we had to leave it for the time being. The fellow was genuinely honest—he left without once pushing any suitable product on us.

text: 孩子上课，我就在外面淘宝，眼花缭乱，不可靠的推荐太多
en: While the child was in class I browsed Taobao outside; dazzled by it all, there were far too many unreliable recommendations.

text: 下午两点到四点带儿子训练足球，在家东边十公里，完了送回家，再去自己的球队玩会，在家西边十公里，四点半开始，五点到的，吹吹牛、打替补，踢了半个小时，出点汗，上车想起来看一眼咸鱼，淘了个同品牌的闲置品，有意思
en: From two to four in the afternoon I took my son to football training ten kilometres east of home; after dropping him back I went to play a bit with my own team, ten kilometres west of home, starting at half past four and arriving at five. We chatted, I played as a substitute, kicked about for half an hour and broke a sweat; getting into the car I remembered to glance at Xianyu and picked up a second-hand item of the same brand—quite interesting.

text: 周日对方发货，周一下午到了，忙完工作到家六点半，晚上吃完饭洗好碗，就开始换，没有称手的工具，好歹拆下来了，忙忙乎乎一个半小时
en: The seller dispatched on Sunday and it arrived Monday afternoon. I got home at half past six after work; after dinner and washing up in the evening I started the replacement. Without the right tools I somehow got it off, bustling about for an hour and a half.

text: 期间接了两个电话，回复了三条微信
en: During that time I took two calls and replied to three WeChat messages.

text: 一个是大学同学，亲戚家小弟犯事儿，进了我们老家的省级监狱，之前已经了解情况，找了作法医的初中同学，答应来了帮忙照应，今天是刚启程
en: One was a university classmate: a younger relative had got into trouble and been sent to the provincial prison in our hometown. I had already looked into it and found a middle-school classmate who is a forensic doctor, who promised to come and help look after him. He set off just today.

text: 一个是在青岛本地的朋友，咨询孕产事宜，平时瞎热心，能帮忙就帮忙，明天再问问吧
en: One was a friend local to Qingdao, consulting about pregnancy and childbirth. I am usually keen to help for no particular reason, so I will lend a hand where I can and ask again tomorrow.

text: 还有一个是同事，约了明天上午拜访服务对象，核对时间，发了车牌号
en: Another was a colleague; we arranged a home visit to a client tomorrow morning, confirmed the time and sent the licence plate number.

text: 家里几位长辈人至中年，遭遇各种变故，看在眼里，始终心存敬畏之心，目前看也只是刚刚好，隐约体会到树欲静而风不止的意味，不折腾，忙里偷闲读点无用之书，砥砺前行，中年需要稳定输出
en: Several elders in my family reached middle age and met with various upheavals; seeing this, I have always held them in reverence. For now it seems just about right, and I vaguely sense the meaning of 'the tree wishes to be still, but the wind will not cease'. I make no fuss, steal idle moments amid the busyness to read some useless books, and press on. Middle age needs steady output.

text: 如有余力，多结善缘，纵向难度大，横向还可以
en: If one has energy to spare, forge more good connections; the vertical is difficult, but the horizontal is still feasible.

text: 现在40岁左右的中年人，会不会选择躺平呢？
en: Would middle-aged people around 40 now choose to lie flat?

text: 我想，不会吧。
en: I think, surely not.

text: 这个年龄段的人正是上有老下有小的顶梁柱，选择躺平了，家里的老小怎么办？
en: People of this age are exactly the pillars with elders above and children below; if they choose to lie flat, what becomes of the old and young at home?

text: 那是不负责任的一种表现。
en: That would be an irresponsible way to be.

text: 如果是我，绝不会选择躺平的，真要这样，那就彻底失去价值了。
en: If it were me, I would never choose to lie flat; if I truly did, I would lose all value completely.

text: 所以，心态和行动力都很重要。
en: So both mindset and drive matter greatly.

text: 要千方百计、全力以赴的去行动。
en: One must act by every possible means and with all one's might.

text: 特别是在这个充满变数和不确定的时候。
en: Especially at a time so full of variables and uncertainty.

text: 中年人经历过很多磨难和挫折后，今后的人生不会太差吧。
en: After middle-aged people have weathered much hardship and many setbacks, their life ahead should not be too bad.

text: 1.革命尚未成功，同志还需努力。
en: 1. The revolution is not yet accomplished; comrades still need to strive.

text: 我继续努力赚钱。
en: I continue to strive to earn money.

text: 2.关我屁事！
en: 2. None of my bloody business!

text: 关你屁事！
en: None of your bloody business!

text: 坚决不内耗，爱谁谁！
en: Absolutely no inward overthinking—whoever it is, I don't care!

text: 3.为自己活着，只考虑生我的和我生的。
en: 3. Live for oneself; consider only those who gave me life and those I gave life to.

text: 前阵子期末家长座谈会，还没结婚的小班主任跟我们几个她觉得有问题的孩子家长沟通，一共留了六个家长，我也没惯着她，很多事跟她一个小年轻说不明白。
en: Recently at the end-of-term parents' meeting, the young unmarried form teacher spoke with us few parents of children she deemed problematic; six parents were kept behind. I did not humour her—many things simply cannot be explained to a youngster like her.

text: 回家我跟孩子沟通一起骂老师解气，哈哈哈哈。
en: Back home I talked with my child and we cursed the teacher together to vent, hahahaha.

text: 我家孩子不是普通的那种被压迫，被妈宝的“听话”中国宝宝。
en: My child is not the ordinary sort of oppressed, mummy's-boy 'obedient' Chinese baby.

text: 我家娃我说实话比这个硕士刚毕业的小姑娘班主任要成熟，看问题要深刻。
en: To be honest, my kid is more mature than this little form teacher who just graduated with a master's, and sees things more deeply.

text: 所以，我家娃让我别搭理她，也没必要教小班主任成熟，哈哈哈。
en: So my kid told me not to bother with her, and there is no need to teach the young form teacher maturity, hahaha.

text: 我们也不补课，老师所谓的什么表现，其实就是一切向成绩看。
en: We do not do extra tutoring either; what the teacher calls 'performance' is really just everything oriented toward grades.

text: 成绩好的给学校炸了学校也维护，我家这个这学期有所下降，就扣帽子，什么心思不在学习上，什么还要不要高考之类的。
en: Those with good grades—even if they blew up the school, the school would defend them; my child's grades dipped this term, so they stick on labels: things like 'mind not on studies' and 'whether they still want to sit the gaokao'.

text: 回顾半生，一路走来全靠命好。
en: Looking back over half a lifetime, the whole way through I have relied entirely on good fortune.

text: 父母有责任心，虽然在农村没钱却一直供我读书；脑袋生得灵光，在西部农村读中学考了985；和高中同桌谈恋爱然后结婚，没有吃爱情的苦；
en: My parents were responsible; though poor in the countryside they always funded my schooling. I was blessed with a quick mind, and at a rural middle school in the west I got into a 985 university. I fell in love with my high-school deskmate and then married her, never tasting the bitterness of love.

text: 结婚以后公婆帮忙带孩子，我没有中断职业生涯；婆婆超级贤惠勤劳心疼我，公公大气又洒脱，没有家庭矛盾；公婆为人处世和眼界胸怀根本不像在底层受了几十年苦的人；
en: After marriage my husband's parents helped raise the child, so I did not interrupt my career. My mother-in-law is supremely virtuous, hardworking and considerate of me; my father-in-law is magnanimous and free-spirited; there were no family conflicts. In their conduct and breadth of vision, my in-laws are nothing like people who have suffered at the bottom for decades.

text: 老公事业发展不错，没有经济压力；儿女双全，聪明活泼懂事上进，比我和老公会读书；所学专业近几年逆势上涨，目前没有失业风险，
en: My husband's career has gone well, with no financial pressure. I have both a son and a daughter, clever, lively, sensible and ambitious, better at studying than my husband and me. The field I studied has risen against the trend in recent years, and for now there is no risk of unemployment.

text: 自己认为很简单的工作，受到一致好评。
en: Work that I myself consider quite simple has met with uniform praise.

text: 个人几乎没有努力，全靠命运的馈赠，我非常知足及感恩。
en: Personally I have hardly striven at all; it is entirely the gift of fate. I am deeply content and grateful.
